_comment: Canonical course category taxonomy for Weld Australia training.
The client's four training divisions are a display-layer grouping over the
HubDB `courses.category` SELECT options - the HubDB values are NOT changed.
This file is the single source of truth. `pnpm build` generates:
theme/templates/partials/course-taxonomy.html  (HubL macros)
src/shared/courseTaxonomy.ts                   (TypeScript, for React islands)
Edit this JSON, never the generated files.
`hubdbValues` must match the option NAMES in hubdb/courses.json `category`.
src/shared/courseTaxonomy.test.ts fails the build if an option is unmapped.
`aliases` keep old inbound links working (e.g. /courses?category=inspector
generated by theme/templates/pages/certification.html). Slugified forms of
each hubdbValue and of the bucket slug itself are added automatically by the
generator - only list aliases that cannot be derived.
`url` is where every 'View <division> courses' link points. It is the
deep-linked /courses listing rather than the /training/<division>-courses/
page because those four pages are not created in HubSpot yet - QA 226/227
reported the division links as broken 404s. training-category.html still
derives its own filter from the page URL, so once the pages exist these
values can be switched back to /training/<division>-courses/ and the links
follow with a `pnpm build`.
